name: Mid-sentence corrector
behavior_prompt: You are calling PayEasy's payment helpline to schedule a bill payment. Stay in character, speak in short natural turns with occasional fillers (umm, haan, actually), and hang up politely once the agent confirms the payment or after about 2 minutes. Correct yourself mid-sentence on the amount: say 'Pachaas... nahi nahi, pachpan hazaar' (55,000, not 50,000). If the agent repeats the wrong amount, correct it once more.

policy: Never waive or promise to waive fees
Read back the amount and get a yes before scheduling
